# Flow sampler parity fixture

Generated by `tools/parity/flow_sampler_dump_reference.py` with PyTorch
float32 tensors. The fixture covers a time-dependent velocity field in two
independent integration cases: seven-step linear Euler without CFG, and
eight-step F5 sway Heun with dual-forward CFG at scale 1.75.

Regenerate from `tools/parity`:

```sh
uv run flow_sampler_dump_reference.py
```

The Rust test reads the three little-endian float32 files directly and uses a
fixed `2e-6` maximum absolute-error gate. The reference script does not call
or translate the Rust sampler.
